title: Marcos on mothballed Bataan Nuclear Power Plant: 'Too bad they stopped it'
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. expressed disappointment as he looked back on the mothballed Bataan Nuclear Power Plant while visiting a nuclear research facility here in Singapore.
